newsitem.title: USA: Republic Industries to buy two companies.
newsitem.headline: Republic Industries to buy two companies.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc. said Wednesday it has definitive agreements to acquire Shad Management Co. and AAA Disposal Services Inc. in separate deals worth a total of $120 million in stock.
Shad Management owns and operates Ford, Chrysler-Plymouth and Jeep-Eagle dealerships in the Jacksonville, Fla., market.
AAA Disposal provides solid waste collection services to residential, commercial and industrial customers in northeast Virginia.
Republic, led by Florida billionaire Wayne Huizenga, has been aggressively acquiring companies in the past year in the automotive, solid waste and electronic security industries.
The Fort Lauderdale, Fla.-based company's stock fell 50 cents to $37.875 early on Nasdaq.
